reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, defaulting a backend to a model that was retired yesterday is worth fixing fast, and the test that fails on `main` is the right proof.

Checked at `4abea8a`: the new entries go first in `VERTEXAI_MODELS`, so `GetVertexAIModelOrDefault` falls back to `gemini-3.8-flash` and keeps a configured Gemini 3 model instead of swapping it; the 2.x and 1.5 entries stay so existing configs still pass validation. The code looks right.

Two things before this can go in:

- `validate` fails because the single commit is `fix(vertexai): ...` and this repo's semantic-PR check only allows the `deps` scope. Amending the commit to `fix: default Vertex AI to gemini-3.8-flash and accept Gemini 3 models` (matching the PR title) will clear it.
- I couldn't reach Google's model-versions page from here to confirm the `gemini-3.8-flash` and `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` ids and the dates in the comments, so those rest on your check. If you can paste the relevant lines from that page in the PR, a maintainer can verify at a glance.

The License Compliance failure is `main`'s (#1850), not yours.

Thanks for amending the commit and for the dated notes from the model versions page. `validate` is green now, so the scope issue is closed.

On the model ids: I can't reach the Vertex AI docs from here, so I'm taking the names and retirement dates in the code comments as your checked-on-2026-10-19 reading of that page rather than something I verified independently. The code change itself is what the description says: `gemini-3.8-flash` first in `VERTEXAI_MODELS` so it's the default, `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` added, the 2.x and 1.5 entries kept so existing configs keep working, and the three new test cases cover the default and both new ids.

Approving. License Compliance is red from `main` (#1850), not from this diff, so no merge sign-off from me; Alex can take it from here.

Re-checked at 6fbbd44: the new commit is a merge of upstream `main` with no change to `googlevertexai.go` or its test, so the approval stands at this head. License Compliance is green now that #1850 is settled; build and tests still need the fork-workflow approval before they run, so no merge sign-off from me yet.

The blocker from my last review has cleared: build and golangci-lint ran at 6fbbd44 and are green, alongside validate, DCO, EasyCLA, License Compliance and codecov. Head is unchanged from the approved one.

Good to merge.

comments.body:
Thanks for checking. The commit is amended to `fix: default Vertex AI to gemini-3.8-flash and accept Gemini 3 models`, same tree as before.

On the model ids and dates, from the Vertex AI model versions page (https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/learn/model-versions), as checked on 2026-10-19:
- `gemini-2.5-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash` and `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`: retirement date 2026-10-20, with `gemini-3.8-flash` listed as the recommended replacement.
- `gemini-3.8-flash` and `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`: generally available, no retirement date before 2027.
